native_case.source_origin_resource_id_basis: provider catalog geometry reference, not a simulated pick/origin identifier

native_case.receiver_identifier_basis: derived from provider SEED codes using FDSN Source Identifiers v1.0
native_case.receiver_vertical_datum_basis: NCEDC documents station elevations and catalog geoid depth on the same datum; StationXML supplies no explicit vertical-datum field
native_case.receiver_elevation_semantics: Channel/Elevation interpreted as sensor elevation per StationXML; no separate burial correction
native_case.receiver_metadata_epoch_basis: Intersection of provider StationXML network, station and channel epochs
